research.title: Negation Sensitivity in Natural Language Inference
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing inference models on sentence pairs with explicit negation, lexical substitutions, and matched affirmative controls.
Analyzed prediction changes across contradiction and entailment examples, separating errors associated with negation scope from lexical overlap effects.

research.title: Cross-Domain Robustness of Support Request Classification
bullets: Designed transfer experiments comparing sparse lexical classifiers and pretrained text encoders across support request domains using consistent label mappings.
Analyzed classwise errors and confidence calibration under domain shift, examining effects of vocabulary mismatch and ambiguous request descriptions.

publications.title: Vocabulary Mismatch and Calibration in Cross-Domain Support Request Classification

work.title: Text Processing Maintenance for Document Search
bullets: Implemented assigned fixes to document normalization and query preprocessing, preserving existing interfaces between text ingestion and search components.
Added regression tests for malformed input and inconsistent whitespace, and documented reproduction steps for reported search behavior defects.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Extractive Summarization Methods
bullets: Implemented sentence ranking with term frequency weighting and graph centrality, alongside a lead sentence baseline for news summarization.
Compared summaries using reference overlap measures and manual checks of redundancy, examining how sentence selection changed across document lengths.

projects.title: Character and Word Representations for Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented word and character n-gram classifiers with linear models, using shared data partitions and consistent preprocessing for comparison.
Evaluated performance on clean and synthetically perturbed reviews, categorizing errors involving misspellings, negation, and mixed sentiment expressions.
